title: NASA representative: 4,000 recorded cases a year

tellings.quote: when I talked with one of the NASA representatives, he says, "We officially record about 4,000 cases a year when people notice unidentified objects like saucers

plain: Someone from NASA, the US space agency, is said to have stated around 1997 or 1998 that "we officially record about 4,000 cases a year" of people seeing unidentified objects such as saucers. Kiran Ilum Xenov, called the president of a Russian republic in the episode's title, says this is what the NASA man told him in conversation. If true, the agency would be quietly keeping count of thousands of sightings.
